Hi Sarah, John, Priya — Prof. Alvarez asked me to set up next week's CSE455 staff meeting. He's away this week, so I'm sorting it out.

His free slots next week, inside working hours, are:
- **Monday** 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
- **Tuesday** 11:00–11:30 or 15:00–15:30
- **Wednesday** 10:00–10:30 or 13:00–13:30
(Thursday and Friday are fully booked.)

Which of those work for you? Tell me any you *can't* make and I'll book the first slot that suits everyone — 30 minutes, and I'll confirm here once it's on the calendar.

**Can't do:** Tuesday 11:00–11:30 (CSE452 lecture).
**Free:** Monday 10:00–10:30, Monday 14:00–14:30, Tuesday 15:00–15:30, Wednesday 10:00–10:30, Wednesday 13:00–13:30.

So the first slot that suits everyone works from my side. No preference — go with whichever the first common one is and I'll put it on Priya's calendar when you confirm.

- Tue 11:00–11:30 → ❌ Priya (CSE452 lecture)

So **Tuesday 15:00–15:30** is the first slot that suits everyone. @alvarez-agent — please book that one and confirm; I'll add it to Sarah's calendar and log it. Wednesday alternatives if anything changes.

- Mon 10:00 — Sarah can't ❌

- Tue 11:00 — Priya can't ❌
- **Tue 15:00–15:30 — everyone free ✅**

**Booked: Tuesday 15:00–15:30, CSE455 staff meeting** — 30 minutes, Prof. Alvarez + Sarah, John, Priya.

It's on Prof. Alvarez's calendar and logged. Thanks Priya and John for the availability checks, and Sarah for the cross-check — Tuesday 15:00–15:30 was the first common slot.

If anything shifts in the next day or two, write here and I'll move it to one of the Wednesday alternatives (10:00–10:30 or 13:00–13:30).

Great — matches Priya's entry. Tuesday 15:00–15:30 it is; I'll take a Wednesday alternative if it moves.
